preamble: Lambdacism is the shift of a sound (often [r]) to [l]. It is a common liquid interchange, frequently occurring as a form of dissimilation or in specific dialectal developments.

examples.note: Everyday Bangkok speech regularly replaces /r/ with [l]; careful speech keeps the tap or trill
PI *ɹ > Cherokee l; Northern Iroquoian keeps *ɹ (*-tsiɹ-)

examples.from: Sidamo harre /ˈhaɾːe/, Burji harre, Kambaata harreta 'donkeys'
examples.note: In the Hadiyya liquid merger the geminate is realized -ll-, so *rr surfaces as /lː/ (Hudson 1989).

languageExamples.language: Proto-Central Chadic to Proto-Central Chadic North

examples.to: Proto-North *la; Margi, Mandara, Mofu, Lamang, Higi groups la
examples.note: South sub-branch groups keep ra (Bata, Daba, Tera).

examples.to: Proto-North *kɨlɨpʸ; Margi group kɨlfiʸ, Higi group kɨlipɨ

examples.note: Proto-Central Chadic had no *l; every North l continues *r.
An independent *r → l in the South sub-branch; the neighbouring Bata group keeps hɨr.

Forms in Eddyshaw's transcription: POV *r = the approximant [ɹ], y = [j], j = [ɟ], ɩ ʋ = [ɪ ʊ], a tilde below a vowel marks nasalization; POV = Proto-Oti-Volta. Western Oti-Volta has y (Mooré -yìibú); Nawdm alone keeps r (-réɦ).
Yom has the same initial *r → l (Yom lewe 'close', -lɛ 'two').

Forms in Eddyshaw's transcription: POV *r = the approximant [ɹ], y = [j], j = [ɟ], ɩ ʋ = [ɪ ʊ], a tilde below a vowel marks nasalization; POV = Proto-Oti-Volta. The r of the EGG-gender singular suffix survived into Proto-Western Oti-Volta; Dagbani merged it with l, while Kusaal nɔ̄ɔrɛ́ and Mampruli noori keep r.
Compare Kusaal tʋ̀bʋrɛ̄, Mampruli tubri; in major-conjugation verbs Dagbani has r (kpari 'lock', Kusaal kpàrɛ̀).
Proto-Saharan reconstructions are Cyffer's (2020, Oxford Handbook of African Languages) as tabulated on Wikipedia. Teda-Daza tirmẽ́su and Beria tàmsī do not show l here.
Teda-Daza kólú has the same l; *kurum 'knee' keeps r in Kanuri ngurumngurum.
Blust reconstructs *R as an alveolar trill; Bunun has l for it in all positions shown.
